description: Deletes a search with its leads and outreach; a running one is stopped first. Nothing is refunded and it cannot be undone. Ask the user to confirm and pass confirm=true. [REST: DELETE /api/tasks/{id}]

task_id.description: The search id (task id), e.g. from list_searches or create_search.

name: delete_search
title: Delete a search (destructive)
